--allow-certificate-chain.help: allow X.509 certificate chains in bundle verification material for v0.3+ bundles

--allow-http-registry.help: whether to allow using HTTP protocol while connecting to registries. Don't use this for anything but testing

--allow-insecure-registry.help: whether to allow insecure connections to registries (e.g., with expired or self-signed TLS certificates). Don't use this for anything but testing

--attachment.help: DEPRECATED, related image attachment to sign (sbom), default none

--attachment-tag-prefix.help: optional custom prefix to use for attached image tags. Attachment images are tagged as: `[AttachmentTagPrefix]sha256-[TargetImageDigest].[AttachmentName]`

--b64.help: whether to base64 encode the output

--base-config.help: path to base signing config file to use as starting point. Service flags will replace services from the base config.

--base-image-only.help: only verify the base image (the last FROM image in the Dockerfile)

--bundle.help: path to bundle containing signature (alias for payload)

--certificate.help: path to the X.509 certificate in PEM format to include in the OCI Signature

--certificate-email.help: the email expected in a valid Fulcio certificate

--certificate-github-workflow-name.help: contains the workflow claim from the GitHub OIDC Identity token that contains the name of the executed workflow.

--certificate-github-workflow-ref.help: contains the ref claim from the GitHub OIDC Identity token that contains the git ref that the workflow run was based upon.

--certificate-github-workflow-repository.help: contains the repository claim from the GitHub OIDC Identity token that contains the repository that the workflow run was based upon

--certificate-github-workflow-sha.help: contains the sha claim from the GitHub OIDC Identity token that contains the commit SHA that the workflow run was based upon.

--certificate-github-workflow-trigger.help: contains the event_name claim from the GitHub OIDC Identity token that contains the name of the event that triggered the workflow run

--certificate-identity.help: The identity expected in a valid Fulcio certificate. Valid values include email address, DNS names, IP addresses, and URIs. Either --certificate-identity or --certificate-identity-regexp must be set for keyless flows.

--certificate-identity-regexp.help: A regular expression alternative to --certificate-identity. Accepts the Go regular expression syntax described at https://golang.org/s/re2syntax. Either --certificate-identity or --certificate-identity-regexp must be set for keyless flows.

--certificate-oidc-issuer.help: The OIDC issuer expected in a valid Fulcio certificate, e.g. https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com or https://oauth2.sigstore.dev/auth. Either --certificate-oidc-issuer or --certificate-oidc-issuer-regexp must be set for keyless flows.

--certificate-oidc-issuer-regexp.help: A regular expression alternative to --certificate-oidc-issuer. Accepts the Go regular expression syntax described at https://golang.org/s/re2syntax. Either --certificate-oidc-issuer or --certificate-oidc-issuer-regexp must be set for keyless flows.

--check-claims.help: if true, verifies the digest exists in the in-toto subject (using either the provided digest and digest algorithm or the provided blob's sha256 digest). If false, only the DSSE envelope is verified.

--ctfe.help: ctfe service specification, as a comma-separated key-value list.\nRequired keys: url, public-key (path to PEM-encoded public key), start-time. Optional keys: end-time, origin.

--ctfe-url.help: URL of the certificate transparency log.

--digest.help: Digest to use for verifying in-toto subject (instead of providing a blob)

--digestAlg.help: Digest algorithm to use for verifying in-toto subject (instead of providing a blob)

--dir.help: path to directory where the signed image is stored on disk

--experimental-oci11.help: set to false to ignore OCI 1.1 behavior

--file.help: path to the wasm file to upload

--fulcio.help: fulcio service specification, as a comma-separated key-value list.\nRequired keys: url, api-version (integer), start-time, operator. Optional keys: end-time.

--fulcio-auth-flow.help: fulcio interactive oauth2 flow to use for certificate from fulcio. Defaults to determining the flow based on the runtime environment. (options) normal|device|token|client_credentials

--fulcio-uri.help: URI of the Fulcio server issuing certificates.

--hash.help: hash of blob in hexadecimal (base16). Used if you want to sign an artifact stored elsewhere and have the hash

--identity-token.help: identity token to use for certificate from fulcio. the token or a path to a file containing the token is accepted.

--insecure-skip-verify.help: skip verifying fulcio published to the SCT (this should only be used for testing).

--issue-certificate.help: issue a code signing certificate from Fulcio, even if a key is provided

--issuer.help: trusted issuer to use for identity tokens, e.g. https://accounts.google.com

--k8s-keychain.help: whether to use the kubernetes keychain instead of the default keychain (supports workload identity).

--key.help: path to the private key file, KMS URI or Kubernetes Secret

--kms.help: create key pair in KMS service to use for signing

--local-image.help: whether the specified image is a path to an image saved locally via 'cosign save'

--maintainers.help: list of maintainers to add to the root policy

--management-key.help: management key, uses default if empty

--max-workers.help: the amount of maximum workers for parallel executions

--mirror.help: GCS bucket to a SigStore TUF repository, or HTTP(S) base URL, or file:/// for local filestore remote (air-gap)

--module-path.help: absolute path to the PKCS11 module

--namespace.help: registry namespace that the root policy belongs to

--new-PIN.help: new PIN, uses default if empty

--new-bundle-format.help: attach a Sigstore bundle using OCI referrers API

--new-key.help: new management key, uses default if empty

--new-pin.help: new PIN, uses default if empty

--new-puk.help: new PUK, uses default if empty

--no-default-ctfe.help: removes the default CTFE URLs from the trusted root.

--no-default-fulcio.help: removes the default Fulcio URLs from the signing config.

--no-default-oidc.help: removes the default OIDC provider URLs from the signing config.

--no-default-rekor.help: removes the default Rekor URLs from the signing config.

--no-default-tsa.help: removes the default TSA URLs from the signing config.

--no-tlog-upload.help: whether to not upload the transparency log

--no-upload.help: do not upload the generated attestation, but send the attestation output to STDOUT

--offline.help: only verify an artifact's inclusion in a transparency log using a provided proof, rather than querying the log. May still include network requests to retrieve service keys from a TUF repository

--oidc-client-secret-file.help: Path to file containing OIDC client secret for application

--oidc-disable-ambient-providers.help: Disable ambient OIDC providers. When true, ambient credentials will not be read

--oidc-issuer.help: OIDC provider to be used to issue ID token

--oidc-provider.help: Specify the provider to get the OIDC token from (Optional). If unset, all options will be tried. Options include: [spiffe, google, github-actions, filesystem, buildkite-agent]

--oidc-redirect-url.help: OIDC redirect URL (Optional). The default oidc-redirect-url is 'http://localhost:0/auth/callback'.

--old-key.help: existing management key, uses default if empty

--old-pin.help: existing PIN, uses default if empty

--old-puk.help: existing PUK, uses default if empty

--only.help: custom string array to only copy specific items, this flag is comma delimited. ex: --only=sig,att,sbom

--out.help: path to the output upgraded bundle file

--outfile.help: path to a payload file to use rather than generating one

--output.help: format to output attestation information in. (text|json)

--output-key-prefix.help: name used for generated .pub and .key files (defaults to `cosign`)

--output-payload.help: write the signed payload to FILE

--payload.help: path to the payload covered by the signature

--pin.help: pin of the PKCS11 slot, uses environment variable COSIGN_PKCS11_PIN if empty

--platform.help: only copy container image and its signatures for a specific platform image

--policy.help: specify CUE or Rego files with policies to be used for validation

--private-infrastructure.help: skip transparency log verification when verifying artifacts in a privately deployed infrastructure

--puk.help: existing PUK, uses default if empty

--random-management-key.help: if set to true, generates a new random management key and deletes it after

--record-creation-timestamp.help: set the createdAt timestamp in the attestation artifact to the time it was created; by default, cosign sets this to the zero value

--recursive.help: if a multi-arch image is specified, additionally sign each discrete image

--registry-cacert.help: path to the X.509 CA certificate file in PEM format to be used for the connection to the registry

--registry-client-cert.help: path to the X.509 certificate file in PEM format to be used for the connection to the registry

--registry-client-key.help: path to the X.509 private key file in PEM format to be used, together with the 'registry-client-cert' value, for the connection to the registry

--registry-referrers-mode.help: mode for fetching references from the registry. allowed: legacy, oci-1-1

--registry-server-name.help: SAN name to use as the 'ServerName' tls.Config field to verify the mTLS connection to the registry

--rekor.help: rekor service specification, as a comma-separated key-value list.\nRequired keys: url, api-version (integer), start-time, operator. Optional keys: end-time.

--rekor-config.help: rekor configuration. Required if --rekor is provided. One of: ANY, ALL, EXACT:<count>

--rfc3161-timestamp-bundle.help: path to an RFC 3161 timestamp bundle FILE

--root.help: path to trusted initial root. defaults to embedded root

--root-checksum.help: checksum of the initial root, required if root is downloaded via http(s). expects sha256 by default, can be changed to sha512 by providing sha512:<checksum>

--sbom.help: path to the sbom, or {-} for stdin

--show-sensitive-values.help: show values of sensitive environment variables

--sign-container-identity.help: manually set the .critical.docker-reference field for the signed identity, which is useful when image proxies are being used where the pull reference should match the signature, this flag is comma delimited. ex: --sign-container-identity=identity1,identity2

--signature.help: path to the signature, or {-} for stdin

--signing-config.help: path to a signing config file

--sk.help: whether to use a hardware security key

--slot-id.help: id of the PKCS11 slot, uses 0 if empty

--timestamp-client-cacert.help: path to the X.509 CA certificate file in PEM format to be used for the connection to the TSA Server

--timestamp-client-cert.help: path to the X.509 certificate file in PEM format to be used for the connection to the TSA Server

--timestamp-client-key.help: path to the X.509 private key file in PEM format to be used, together with the 'timestamp-client-cert' value, for the connection to the TSA Server

--timestamp-server-name.help: SAN name to use as the 'ServerName' tls.Config field to verify the mTLS connection to the TSA Server

--timestamp-server-url.help: url to the Timestamp RFC3161 server, default none. Must be the path to the API to request timestamp responses, e.g. https://freetsa.org/tsr

--timestamp-uri.help: URI of the timestamp authority server.

--tlog-upload.help: whether or not to upload to the tlog

--trusted-root.help: optional path to a TrustedRoot JSON file to verify a signature after signing

--tsa.help: timestamping authority specification, as a comma-separated key-value list.\nRequired keys: url, api-version (integer), start-time, operator. Optional keys: end-time.

--tsa-config.help: timestamping authority configuration. Required if --tsa is provided. One of: ANY, ALL, EXACT:<count>

--tsr.help: path to the Time Stamped Signature Response from RFC3161 compliant TSA

--use-signing-config.help: whether to use a TUF-provided signing config for the service URLs

--with-default-rekor-v2.help: use the Sigstore TUF root, with the Rekor v2 service, as default values to populate the signing config. Specifying the other service flags will override the default values.

--with-default-services.help: use the Sigstore TUF root as default values to populate the signing config. Specifying the other service flags will override the default values.

--yes.help: skip confirmation prompts for non-destructive operations
